description: This file defines the CursoRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository for managing Curso entities. It includes custom query methods to find courses by name and by professor.

classes.name: CursoRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Curso entity with custom query methods.

methods.name: findByNomCurso
methods.description: Finds a Curso entity by its course name.

methods.name: findAllByProfesor
methods.description: Finds all Curso entities associated with a given Professor.
